newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close lower, doubts over Jpn recovery.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close lower, doubts over Jpn recovery.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed moderately lower on Wednesday, as sentiment was hurt by doubts over Japan's economic recovery and concerns over the financial health of the nation's firms, brokers said.
These worries prompted active sales, especially in the futures market, they said.
The 225-share Nikkei average lost 156.72 points or 0.79 percent to close at 19,697.17. The index briefly slid as low as 19,495.85.
The Nikkei's September futures dropped 220 points to 19,700.
